Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sunita - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Nitin - 39 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Aarav - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Ayaan stands on the road. Sunita and Nitin stand near him.]

Sunita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ayaan sits in the back seat.]

Nitin: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Ayaan (laughing): "Show me too!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ayaan in the back.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita, Nitin and Aarav stand near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan claps his hands.]

Ayaan (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan waves goodbye to Mother.]

Sunita: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Sunita, Nitin and Aarav stand near him.]

Nitin: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Nitin: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Aarav (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Ayaan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan (softly): "And then?"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Nitin: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
